grain: One row per trade type code (TT_ID), representing a distinct trade type such as Limit Buy, Limit Sell, Market Buy, Market Sell, or Stop Loss.
assumptions: All target fields are sourced from the TradeType table, so no joins to other source tables are required.
TradeType.TT_ID is the primary key and is unique across the 5 source rows, so no de-duplication is needed.
The Historical Load reads all rows from the Batch 1 TradeType source file.
